At @FieldaysNZ NZTE and NZ Inc partners connected Kiwi agritech businesses with international customers, investors and visitors. #Agritech #NZExporters NZTE @NZTEnews Jun 4 Nearly 85% of NZ’s electricity is renewable, with geothermal a key part. NZTE is partnering with @NZGeothermal, InvestNZ and @Seequentglobal at #WorldGeothermalCongress 2026 in Calgary. Kiwi companies will showcase NZ expertise and build global clean energy partnerships. NZTE @NZTEnews May 27 NZTE is proud to support the @ASBBank Export Awards, celebrating the businesses driving impact for New Zealand. Bay of Plenty exporters: entries for the 2026 Awards close in two weeks. Now’s the time to share your export journey. Enter now: exportnz.org.nz/event/asb-bay-… #NZExports NZTE @NZTEnews May 26 That’s a wrap on @digitalhlthfest 2026. New Zealand was well represented, with 60 businesses attending, including 26 featured on the New Zealand Pavilion, helping showcase the depth and strength of our healthtech sector. A huge thank you to the New Zealand Pavilion businesses NZTE @NZTEnews May 24 NZTE is proud to support Electrify Aotearoa in Auckland (9–10 June), New Zealand’s flagship summit for women founders, investors and the wider startup ecosystem. To find out more and get tickets for Electrify Aotearoa, visit: electrifyaotearoa.co.nz NZTE @NZTEnews May 20 NZTE works with NZ Inc partners to support exporters, with @MPI_NZ helping businesses meet export requirements in New Zealand and overseas. Their free Exporter Help service offers practical advice at any stage. Learn more: mpi.govt.nz/export/get-hel… #NZExporters #FoodAndFibre NZTE @NZTEnews May 13 Final call for NZTE’s @TechweekNZ programme kicking off next week. Explore the programme and secure your spot while registrations are still open: my.nzte.govt.nz/attend/series/… #Techweek26 #NZTech #ExportGrowth #TheArtOfThePossible NZTE @NZTEnews May 12 80%+ of NZ’s $3.9B healthtech revenue is earned offshore, with Australia our largest export market.

In this joint MFAT and @NZTEnews Techweek 2026 session, we explore how trade policy, regulation and market Show more
